original_paragraph.Results - 3.2. Experimental validation o: The binding affinities of the 20 virtual screened compounds toward sclerostin/loop2/loop3, represented by dissociation constant (Kd) values, were determined by surface plasmon resonance (SPR). A total of 8 compounds (Table 1) were found binding to sclerostin, and the binding affinities of other 12 compounds to sclerostin/loop2/loop3 were unsuccessfully determined due to their poor solubility in 1X PBS containing 5 % DMSO. As shown in Table 1, these 8 compounds exhibited nano-molar range binding affinity values towards sclerostin, and six of them could bind to loop2 region while only two compounds bound to loop3 region (Table 1, Fig. 2, S1–S3). Among the six compounds binding to sclerostin loop2, four of them are almost loop2 selective while compound ZINC1117792250 binds to both loop2 and loop3 region. Notably, compound ZINC4228235 (Tetrahydrofolic acid, THFA) with the best binding affinity to sclerostin exhibited selective binding to loop3 domain, because the binding affinity of THFA towards sclerostin loop3 (Kd = 42.43 nM) is similar as the binding affinity to sclerostin (Kd = 37.66 nM), and THFA showed no binding to loop2 domain (Table 1, Fig. 2). Thus, THFA was screened out as the small molecule selectively targeting loop3 region of sclerostin.

original_paragraph.Results - 3.2. Experimental validation o: The binding affinities of the 20 virtual screened compounds toward sclerostin/loop2/loop3, represented by dissociation constant (Kd) values, were determined by surface plasmon resonance (SPR). A total of 8 compounds (Table 1) were found binding to sclerostin, and the binding affinities of other 12 compounds to sclerostin/loop2/loop3 were unsuccessfully determined due to their poor solubility in 1X PBS containing 5 % DMSO. As shown in Table 1, these 8 compounds exhibited nano-molar range binding affinity values towards sclerostin, and six of them could bind to loop2 region while only two compounds bound to loop3 region (Table 1, Fig. 2, S1–S3). Among the six compounds binding to sclerostin loop2, four of them are almost loop2 selective while compound ZINC1117792250 binds to both loop2 and loop3 region. Notably, compound ZINC4228235 (Tetrahydrofolic acid, THFA) with the best binding affinity to sclerostin exhibited selective binding to loop3 domain, because the binding affinity of THFA towards sclerostin loop3 (Kd = 42.43 nM) is similar as the binding affinity to sclerostin (Kd = 37.66 nM), and THFA showed no binding to loop2 domain (Table 1, Fig. 2). Thus, THFA was screened out as the small molecule selectively targeting loop3 region of sclerostin.
